summary: Macros and the Python API now find the ArcRho Server root on a client PC that never saved ArcRho Server Connection.
details: Import ResQ Reserving Class no longer fails with "ArcRho Server root was not found in the ArcRho host config file" when %APPDATA%\ArcRho\workspace_paths.json does not exist.
The server root now resolves from ARCRHO_SERVER_ROOT/ARCRHO_RUNTIME_SERVER_ROOT, then the host config file, then the running ArcRho desktop app, then the packaged default root.
arcrho_api/config.py owns that resolution and the app server reads it, so the desktop app and macros can no longer disagree about the workspace.
